where: AI moves: When it attacks you #2 Through ball between your CBs
text: Their striker level with your last defender and a gap opening between your two CBs. | Don’t step out with a CB. Jockey (LT) goal-side of the runner and let a midfielder press the passer. | Since update 1.1.3 the CPU looks for passes more often and decides quicker. Players report pinpoint through balls between two defenders.

where: AI moves: When it attacks you #3 Sharp dribbler
text: A dribbler cutting back and changing direction instead of running in a straight line. | Jockey (LT) a yard off, on his inside. Never tackle from behind. Tackle (B) when he slows or turns his back. | Update 1.1.3 made the CPU dribble with sharper turns and less time on the ball. EA made tackles from behind less effective, and made jockey quicker in update 1.1.0.

where: AI moves: When it attacks you #4 Late shot from the edge of your box
text: The ball goes wide near your box and their midfielder arrives late at the edge. | Keep one midfielder on the edge. where: AI moves: When it attacks you #5 Crosses into your box
text: A winger with grass ahead of him on the touchline, or already at your byline. | Full-back goal-side and jockey him outside. CBs stay in the box. where: AI moves: When it attacks you #6 Quick passing through your lines
text: Short, fast passes into feet between your midfield and defence. | Stand in the passing lane and let the man come to you. Don’t chase the ball. | Update 1.5.0 made ground passes quicker and more accurate, most of all for good passers. That goes for the CPU too.

where: AI moves: When it attacks you #7 Strong man shielding the ball
text: A big forward with his back to you, holding you off. | Don’t barge him from behind. Stay goal-side, bring a second man with hold RB, and win it when he turns. | Update 1.4.0 gave Strength and Aggression more say in shielding, and EA cut the success of tackles from behind.

where: AI moves: When it attacks you #8 Striker through on your keeper
text: Their striker clean through, your keeper on his line. | Hold Y briefly to bring the keeper halfway, then let him set. Don’t charge all the way. | Update 1.5.0 made chip shots more accurate, more so for strikers with the Chip Shot PlayStyle. The halfway idea itself is a FIFA 23 tip.

where: AI moves: When it attacks you #9 Corners
text: Their strongest players lining up in your box. | Put your strongest headers on the defending-corner jobs FC 26 added: Near Post, Back Post and Threat Marker. | EA added those corner roles in FC 26, and says stronger players now win the box-out when an air ball comes in.

text: Gaps in their back line and a defender a few yards off your striker. | Shoot early with a low driven shot (double-tap B), or slide the runner into the gap. | Squad Battles uses Competitive gameplay. where: AI moves: When it defends #3 Gaps between two defenders

where: AI moves: When it defends #4 Edge of its box left open

text: Two of them stepping up to your man on the ball. | Pass and move. First-time passes, then run into the space they left. | Update 1.1.3 has the CPU switch defenders more often. Red Bull’s FC 26 guide calls first-time passes “extremely powerful”.

where: AI moves: When it defends #6 Blocks up close

where: AI moves: When it defends #7 Keeper in a one-on-one

text: Space at the edge of the box after a cut inside. | Cut inside, then finesse to the far post (RB + B).
